name: copilotprompts-prompt-m365-meeting-conflict-analysis
title: Meeting conflict analysis in your calendar
shortDescription: Prompt to analyze meetings in your calendar for a specified date to identify overlapping or conflicting meetings, and present a clear conflict report.
longDescription: This prompt reviews all meetings for a specified day, detects scheduling conflics, and presents an easy to interpret report with clear visual indicators highlighting any overlapping or conflicts.

thumbnails.alt: Meeting conflict analysis complete with indicators of conflicting meetings
